title: ai_token_metrics plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `ai_token_metrics` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component AiTokenMetricsConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

AiTokenMetricsConfig.description: Plugin: ai_token_metrics — Extracts token usage from HTTP JSON LLM response bodies and from streamed SSE / AWS event-stream responses. Native gRPC protobuf messages are unsupported and the plugin is not registered for the Grpc protocol view. Unknown keys are rejected. Streamed responses are metered incrementally without buffering; buffer_streaming_responses instead collects SSE before inspection and disables live delivery. A collected body above 4 MiB (before decoding) is not inspected. Cohere counts come from usage.tokens, delta.usage.tokens, or meta.tokens, not billed_units; configured cost rates estimate cost from those token counts, not provider billing units.

provider.description: Exact lowercase LLM provider format; surrounding whitespace and alternate casing are rejected. `tgi` selects Hugging Face TGI native `/generate` shapes (`details.generated_tokens`).

buffer_streaming_responses.description: Buffer text/event-stream responses and meter them after the full response is collected; disables streaming delivery for those responses. Not required for SSE token accounting, which observes streams incrementally by default.

cost_per_prompt_token.description: Calculate estimated cost per request from prompt tokens; range 0 through 18446744073709.55. Omitted or null disables this rate.

cost_per_completion_token.description: Calculate estimated cost per request from completion tokens; range 0 through 18446744073709.55. Omitted or null disables this rate.

model_pricing.description: Ordered per-model rate overrides. The first entry whose `model` glob matches the response's reported model supplies the rates (an omitted entry rate leaves that side unpriced); when none matches, or no publishable model is reported, the flat rates apply. Federation usage is priced at the flat rates.

model.description: Anchored glob matched against the response's model; `*` is the only wildcard and never matches URL-structural separators (`/ ? # & \`) or whitespace.

cost_per_prompt_token.description: Prompt-token rate for matching models; null or omitted leaves the prompt side unpriced.

cost_per_completion_token.description: Completion-token rate for matching models; null or omitted leaves the completion side unpriced.
